daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿وَالسَّماءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أقسم" (I swear); ﴿وَالطَّارِقِ﴾: conjoined to السماء.

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿أَدْراكَ﴾: a past verb and its object, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ما أدراك… is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مَا الطَّارِقُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause stands in place of the second object of أدراك.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿النَّجْمُ﴾: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو"; ﴿الثَّاقِبُ﴾: naʿt (adjective); the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle of negation; ﴿كُلُّ نَفْسٍ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), muḍāf to نفس; ﴿لَمَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿عَلَيْها حافِظٌ﴾: fronted khabar (predicate) and postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of كل, and the clause إن… is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿فَلْيَنْظُرِ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; ﴿الْإِنْسانُ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them; ﴿خُلِقَ﴾: a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿خُلِقَ﴾: a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) being latent (mustatir); ﴿مِنْ ماءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿دافِقٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ماء; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿يَخْرُجُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of ماء; ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿الصُّلْبِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿وَالتَّرائِبِ﴾: conjoined to it.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun; ﴿عَلى رَجْعِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them; ﴿لَقادِرٌ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and قادر is the khabar (predicate) of inna; the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time; ﴿تُبْلَى﴾: a passive imperfect verb; ﴿السَّرائِرُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿لَهُ﴾: fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ﴿قُوَّةٍ﴾: genitive in form, nominative in position, the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿ناصِرٍ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿وَالسَّماءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أقسم" (I swear); ﴿ذاتِ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of السماء; ﴿الرَّجْعِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:12-12.t: The clause is conjoined to what precedes it, and the i'rab is the same.

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun; ﴿لَقَوْلٌ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ﴿قول﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿فَصْلٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative, working like laysa; ﴿هُوَ﴾: its noun; ﴿بِالْهَزْلِ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and ﴿الهزل﴾ is genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of ما; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: inna and its noun; ﴿يَكِيدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the wāw being its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna; ﴿كَيْداً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿وَأَكِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿كَيْداً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿فَمَهِّلِ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the apodosis of a condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَمْهِلْهُمْ﴾: an imperative verb and its object, the agent being latent; ﴿رُوَيْداً﴾: naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is a tawkīd (emphasis) of what precedes it.
